question: Which of the following fort was built by Suraj Mal in Bharatpur?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lohagarh Fort**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lohagarh Fort**, located in **Bharatpur, Rajasthan**, was built by **Maharaja Suraj Mal**, the founder of Bharatpur. It is renowned for its strength and resilience against enemy attacks.
 
• Constructed in the **18th century**, Lohagarh Fort stands as a symbol of the **Jat dynasty's valour**. It is often referred to as the “Iron Fort” due to its impenetrable design.
 
• This fort successfully withstood multiple attacks by the British forces, including those led by Lord Lake in **1805**, making it historically significant.
 
• The fort features two imposing gates, the **Ashtadhatu Gate** and the **Chhatrapati Gate**, showcasing intricate craftsmanship and historical narratives.
